task_title: Fix Floor 1 seed-39 boss-contact retreat regression

plan_review.notes: Verdict: approved_with_changes (equivalent to convergent - implementation matched the reviewed root-cause/fix plan exactly). Reviewer confirmed the distance-based carve-out on the ranged-shooter Retreat bail-out is well-targeted and no different architecture is warranted. The 1 actionable concern (test proves symptom, not the exact predicate boundary) was addressed by adding two focused unit tests in tests/game/behavior-tree-ai.test.ts pinning the exact attackRange+distance boundary; confirmed the new predicate-pinning test fails against the pre-fix condition. Reviewer also offered 3 optional non-blocking hardening suggestions (CONTACT_SAFE_ORBIT_FT naming/double-duty, possible similar shape in the mid-floor slime-rat boss, potential boundary thrash) that are follow-up ideas outside this narrowly-scoped bugfix and do not block it.

rounds.notes: Session code_review tool flagged a wall-time/test-timeout mismatch in the new headless regression test (maxWallTimeMs 300000ms > vitest test timeout 120000ms). Fixed by lowering maxWallTimeMs to 90000ms; re-ran the test to confirm it still passes (28s actual runtime). No other findings.

independent_grade.notes: The fix is a single, well-targeted predicate change: the ranged-shooter Retreat bail-out (attackRange > retreatEscapeRadius) now also requires threat.distance > CONTACT_SAFE_ORBIT_FT, so a boss with a large projectile attackRange that has already closed to melee contact no longer suppresses Retreat at critical health. Verified CONTACT_SAFE_ORBIT_FT=4.5 and retreatEscapeRadius=20*1.5=30, so the test setups (attackRange=280 at distance 3 vs distance 10) correctly exercise both sides of the new boundary. The two added unit tests pin the exact predicate boundary and pass. A deterministic paired headless regression test verifies the actual Floor-1 seed-39 throwing-knife victory in the real headless pipeline. The change is narrow, comments explain the rationale clearly. No criterion falls below 3 and no blocker-level issues were found.
